grade_rationale: 6 P1 findings (exceeds C-grade max of 2); 4 exploitable CVEs including RCE and IP spoofing in production backend; 2 spec-drift gaps leave contracted behaviour unimplemented. Performance and chaos specialists ran in static-only mode (services offline).

escalations.title: handlebars — JavaScript Injection via AST Type Confusion (CVSS 9.8)
escalations.reason: Network-reachable RCE if backend processes untrusted Handlebars templates. No precondition required beyond template control.

escalations.title: proxy-addr — IPv4-mapped IPv6 IP Spoofing (Trust Boundary Bypass)
escalations.reason: Any network attacker can craft IPv6 addresses to bypass IP-based access control, rate limiting, and attribution logging. Zero precondition.
escalations.fix: npm update proxy-addr (in Source/Backend); verify Express 4.22+ compatibility

escalations.title: vitest — Code Injection via Unauthenticated Mock Registration (Test Harness Escape)
escalations.reason: Malicious code submitted via PR can escape the test sandbox and execute arbitrary code on developer workstations and CI/CD runners. Affects code review integrity.

findings.title: GET /api/search not implemented in Source/
findings.summary: The search endpoint required by the DependencyPicker typeahead is declared and tested but no route file exists in Source/Backend/src/routes/. All tests will fail on run. The portal/ equivalent is fully implemented.
findings.recommendation: Create Source/Backend/src/routes/search.ts mirroring portal/Backend/src/routes/search.ts; register in Source/Backend/src/app.ts as app.use('/api/search', searchRouter). Add '// Verifies: FR-dependency-search'.

findings.title: dependencyCheckDuration Prometheus histogram missing (FR-dependency-metrics)
findings.summary: Three of four required Prometheus metrics are present; dependencyCheckDuration histogram is entirely absent. BFS traversal in dependency.ts is never timed. Portal reference implementation at portal/Backend/src/metrics.ts:23.
findings.recommendation: Add Histogram for dependency_check_duration_seconds to Source/Backend/src/metrics.ts; instrument hasUnresolvedBlockers / detectCycle in dependency.ts with .startTimer().

findings.title: tinypool — Worker Pool Exhaustion DoS (Vitest dependency)
findings.summary: Vitest's worker pool can be exhausted, causing test hangs or crashes. CI/CD pipelines and local dev environments are affected. Fixed by Vitest upgrade (DEP-003).
findings.recommendation: npm update vitest (in Source/Frontend) — tinypool is pinned by Vitest.

findings.title: FR-dependency-seed requirement has zero implementation
findings.summary: Seed data requirement (BUG-0010 blocked_by BUG-0003/0004/0005/0006/0007, FR-0004 blocked_by FR-0003 etc.) is specified but never implemented in portal/, Source/, or platform/. Invisible to traceability enforcer.
findings.recommendation: Add idempotent seed function in portal/Backend/src/database/schema.ts or a separate seed.ts. Guard inserts with SELECT before INSERT. Add '// Verifies: FR-dependency-seed'.

findings.title: Traceability enforcer blind to portal/ and platform/ — 79+ FRs unverified
findings.summary: Hard-coded source_dirs = ['Source', 'E2E'] misses portal/ (69+ FRs) and platform/ (10 FRs). The CI gate shows green on 13 FR-WF-* requirements while 79+ requirements have no coverage signal. Spec drift in those codebases is invisible.
findings.recommendation: Add portal and platform to source_dirs in enforcer, or add per-codebase enforcer invocations. Update inspector.config.yml to map spec files to implementation directories.

findings.title: eslint-disable in production frontend code violates CLAUDE.md rule
findings.summary: // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps suppresses a React hooks warning. CLAUDE.md explicitly prohibits disabled linting rules.
findings.recommendation: Wrap `filters` in useMemo to stabilize the reference and remove the disable comment, or document an explicit project exception in CLAUDE.md.

findings.title: body-parser — Denial of Service via invalid limit value
brace-expansion — 7 DoS issues via unbounded expansion
browserslist — Unbounded memory growth + prototype write (Backend)
form-data — CRLF injection in multipart fields (Backend)
js-yaml — Arbitrary code execution via YAML parsing (Backend)
findings.fix: npm update js-yaml (Source/Backend, transitive via build tools)

findings.title: browserslist — Unbounded memory growth + prototype write (Frontend)
form-data — CRLF injection in multipart fields (Frontend)
nanoid — Integer overflow, infinite loops (Frontend)
postcss — Arbitrary file read via sourceMappingURL (Frontend)
source-map-js — DoS via source map parsing (Frontend)
vite — esbuild dependency vulnerability (Frontend)
findings.fix: npm update vite (Source/Frontend, may require Node 18+)

findings.title: ws — ReDoS via compression header parsing (Frontend)
Silent JSON parse error suppression with no explanatory comment
findings.summary: response.json().catch(() => ({})) discards parse errors silently. CLAUDE.md requires every catch to log, re-throw, or document suppression.
findings.recommendation: Add inline comment: '// Intentional: non-JSON error bodies (HTML 502 etc.) fall back to empty object; status code is preserved in thrown Error'

findings.title: vite-env.d.ts has no Verifies comment (boilerplate — no action required)
findings.summary: Recently modified Vite-generated ambient type declaration with no business logic. No FR maps to it. Consider adding to enforcer exclusion list.
findings.recommendation: Add to enforcer exclusion list to avoid future false positives. No code change needed.

findings.title: @babel/core — Arbitrary file read via sourceMappingURL (CVSS 3.2)
React Router 6.x — Multiple open redirect vulnerabilities requiring 6→7 migration
findings.recommendation: Plan React Router 6→7 migration. Test all routing scenarios before upgrade.
